remarks: Discover comfort, convenience, and style in this large 2-bedroom condo, featuring generous closet space, on-site parking, and a beautifully maintained community complete with a dog park and sparkling lap pool. Enjoy peace of mind and lower utility bills with a brand-new, energy-efficient HVAC system, newly remodel kitchen.  Perfectly situated just minutes from the SONO Mall, top-rated SONO restaurants, vibrant nightlife, and family friendly activities. Commuters will love the seamless access to I-95, making travel a breeze.  This home delivers the best of modern living in one of the area's most desirable neighborhoods move-in ready, highly convenient, and truly must-see!
